import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

n = int(input().strip())

# Calculate full weeks and remaining days
full_weeks = n // 7
remaining_days = n % 7

# Minimum days off: full weeks contribute 2 days off each
min_days_off = full_weeks * 2

# Maximum days off: add remaining days to 2 days off per full week
max_days_off = min_days_off + min(remaining_days, 2)

print(min_days_off, max_days_off)
